g.text: 36 pleats, folds toward the side seams both sides of CF / CB · face 3 · depth 6 · edge-stitched 2 cm
① section through the pleat seam level (seen from below, schematic: layers spread apart)
to the wearer's LEFT side seam
to the wearer's RIGHT side seam
Fold edges point to the nearest side seam on both sides of CF (and of CB). Face ≈ 3 cm, depth 6 cm → intake 12 cm per pleat, 432 cm in all;
the underlays overlap (PD > PF): ≈ 5 layers under the seam. Panel cut ≈ 560 cm round (4 quarter pieces, joins hidden in a pleat inner fold / in the side seam).
② plan at the pleat seam (wearer's left front, 4 pleats) · edge-stitch 2 cm, then free
edge-stitch 1.5 mm from the fold, 2 cm long, backtacked
fold edge → toward the side seam; free below 2 cm
pleat seam, topstitch 6 mm on the upper body
Level all round at PS = 33 cm below HPS · Hong Kong bound · topstitched 6 mm · placket crosses it
pleated panel: ≈ 5 layers at the seam (basted shut)
allowances graded, Hong Kong bound in cupro bias, pressed UP
placket (separate strip, plain indigo) crosses the pleat seam
15 mm snap, ≥ 4 cm from the seam
paint on the pleat faces only (pleats basted shut while painting)
Point collar on a stand · interfaced · stand snap
N2 46 cm along the neck seam (stand, end to end)
stand snap 12.5 mm (cap on the wearer's left end)
woven fusible in stand + collar (fused after painting, steam-tested)
Point collar on a stand: collar point NP 7.5 cm, stand 3.5 cm at CB. Upper collar + under collar, both interfaced; stand edge-stitched 1.5 mm, collar 1.5 mm. Never painted.
Cap + socket on the top placket · stud + post on the under placket
CAP Ø 15 mm (outside, top placket) + prong ring
8 sets: stand 1 (12.5 mm), placket 5 (15 mm) at S1 = 14 cm below HPS then every SN = 12.5 cm, cuffs 2 (15 mm). Set AFTER painting,
steaming and pressing, through 3–4 plies of wool + fusible; post length to suit the stack (2–4 mm). Fusible patch behind every snap.
Nickel-free; open / close force 15–30 N; pull ≥ 90 N.
Folded 6 cm cuff · 1 snap · tower placket · 2 pleats
tower placket 14 cm (back of the sleeve)
cuff snap 15 mm, cap on the overlap
Folded cuff (outer + inner in one), woven fusible on the outer half, edge-stitched 1.5 mm all round. CW = 12.5 cm closed (cuff − wrist ≈ 8 cm, an overshirt cuff).
Flat-felled · yoke burrito · hem double-turned before pleating
Unlined garment: flat-felled seams (clean inside), pleat seam + pleated-panel joins Hong Kong bound. Hem folds crisply into every pleat after the set.
